frozen: 2026-10-29, committed before any held-crop label exists
heldSet: seed 202610295 (SEED = 20261029_5); H3 exports (read-only); 100 Person + 100 Vehicle Tracks with a crop of shorter side >= 80 px; largest such crop per Track; <= 4 Tracks per run; seeded halves: calibration (even index) and check (odd index)
labels: per crop and applicable attribute: a schema value, present/absent for presence attributes, or unscorable; source and labeller recorded in the qualification note
decision: categorical: argmax value Observed when its softmax p >= threshold; presence: present Observed when p(present) >= threshold; otherwise Unknown
rule: per attribute, the smallest grid threshold whose calibration-half precision (correct Observed / Observed; an unscorable label counts as wrong when Observed) is >= targetPrecision with >= minimumObserved Observed; if none, fallbackThreshold
reported: for the chosen threshold, check-half precision with a Wilson 95% interval and coverage (Observed / items); thresholds are never re-chosen on the check half
